audit_scope: Displayed-note candidates and linked glossary from the selected essential lessons and Quran readers, with the three confirmed Heart Reminder note findings. This is a note extraction gap check supplementing reports/embedded-source-inventory.json, not a claim to re-segment every archived publisher parent.

essential_enumeration.leaf_rule: String value with terminal key text or numeric array index. This intentionally captures metadata identifiers, which are classified separately.

quran_enumeration.leaf_rule: String longer than 15 Unicode code points with terminal key text or numeric array index, and note in its pointer (case-insensitive) or NOTES in its source filename. Short labels are outside this targeted note-body pass.

method.heart_followup: Only the three selected source note locations are added here; the wider Heart Reminder JSON/Markdown comparison is recorded by the embedded source inventory.
method.manual_review: Read the source-note content and scope for independently attributed bounded quotations. Distinguish lexical examples, Quran commentary, cited publisher summaries, and archived parent explanations. Selected boundaries use exact source substrings without normalization.
method.machine_verification: Re-enumerate the selected source documents, verify every source SHA-256 and Git blob SHA-1 from preserved UTF-8 bytes, resolve every JSON pointer, and verify selected excerpt boundaries, excerpt hashes, record IDs, and record text against generated records.
method.coordinates: Half-open Unicode code-point intervals [start, end) in the referenced note string. Quote punctuation is excluded only where the selected source boundary excludes it.
method.duplicate_handling: Repeated note text is tracked by its hash while separate source locations remain visible. The Japanese local lesson mirror is not counted as a new narration.

review_qualification.scope: Source extraction and classification evidence only.
review_qualification.source_grades: Remain attributed to their original sources.
review_qualification.translation_origin: No origin decision is made by this audit; legacy copies remain subject to the Unknown policy.
review_qualification.canonical_number_alignment: Not inferred. Muslim book-local 17, Hakim volume/page 2:338, and the four Bukhari context citations remain qualified in their records.
